problem_text: A block of mass 4 kg is pushed along a frictionless surface by a constant horizontal force of 50 N. Starting from rest, calculate the displacement after 2 seconds. Show each step of the reasoning.
A 2 kg pendulum bob is attached to a 1.5 m string. Calculate the period of oscillation for small angles. Use g = 9.81 m/s².
Calculate the Gibbs free energy change (ΔG) for a reaction at 298 K where ΔH = -92 kJ/mol and ΔS = -198 J/(mol·K). Determine whether the reaction is spontaneous.
